title: RisersSecurity
description: RisersSecurity is a premium Minecraft authentication plugin that protects player accounts with a fast, secure, and reliable login system.
body:
# 🛡️ **RisersSecurity**

> **Protect your server with a fast, lightweight, and dependency-free authentication system.**

**RisersSecurity** is a premium authentication plugin for Paper and Spigot servers that provides a secure register/login system without requiring MySQL, SQLite, or any external libraries. Built with performance and simplicity in mind, it stores player data in clean YAML files while protecting passwords using industry-standard **BCrypt** hashing.

Simple to set up, lightweight to run, and powerful enough to secure your server.

---

# ✨ **Features**

## 🔐 Secure Authentication

Keep player accounts safe with a reliable authentication system.

* **BCrypt password hashing**
* Passwords are **never stored in plain text**
* Secure register and login system
* Change passwords anytime using in-game commands

---

## ⚡ Lightweight & Dependency-Free

No databases.

No external plugins.

No complicated setup.

RisersSecurity is built entirely using the **Bukkit API** and the **Java Standard Library**, making installation quick and maintenance effortless.

---

## 🌍 Spawn Protection

Prevent unauthorized players from exploring your server before logging in.

When an unauthenticated player joins:

* They are teleported to the configured spawn
* Movement is restricted
* Blindness prevents them from seeing their surroundings
* Their original location is securely remembered

After successfully logging in, players are automatically returned to the exact location where they left.

---

## 📍 Location Memory

Players never lose their position.

RisersSecurity remembers where players disconnected and restores them immediately after authentication.

---

## ⏱️ Smart Security Controls

Protect your server from brute-force attempts with configurable security settings.

Features include:

* Login timeout
* Register timeout
* Maximum failed login attempts
* Minimum password length
* Maximum password length
* Session timeout

Everything can be customized through the configuration file.

---

## 🎨 Fully Customizable

Every aspect of the plugin can be personalized.

Customize:

* Prefix
* Colors
* Login messages
* Register messages
* Error messages
* Success messages

Supports traditional Minecraft color codes.

---

## 👮 Admin Tools

Manage your server without restarting it.

Available admin features include:

* Reset player passwords
* Reload the plugin configuration instantly

---

# 📁 Simple Storage

Player information is stored inside a clean and human-readable **playerdata.yml** file.

No SQL databases.

No external services.

Just simple and reliable YAML storage.

---

# ⚙️ Requirements

* **Paper / Spigot 1.21+**
* **Java 21**

---

# ❤️ Why RisersSecurity?

Many authentication plugins rely on external databases or complicated setups.

**RisersSecurity focuses on simplicity without sacrificing security.**

With secure password hashing, zero dependencies, configurable protection, and lightweight performance, it's the perfect authentication solution for both small and large Minecraft servers.

---

# 🚀 Secure Your Server

**Register.**

**Login.**

**Play with confidence.**
